description: Simplify internal authorization for a small company by making COMPANY_ADMIN the owner/operator role with automatic administrator access to internal applications.
deviation_notes: Successor policy to the identity-only COMPANY_ADMIN behavior in company_identity_sso_20260715. It preserves ordinary app roles and the company-identity database boundary while deliberately removing owner role-assignment toil.

sprint.goal: Let the company owner administer every internal application through one intentional COMPANY_ADMIN assignment without maintaining duplicate per-app roles.
